adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is true, the function returns the raw `fetch(...)` result (a `Response`). In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the return value is typed/treated as `HubspotToken` (`const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)`) and the surrounding logic (immediately after this block, per existing implementation pattern) expects token fields from the HubSpot SDK response object. Under the sync-enabled path, those fields will not exist on a `Response` unless `.json()` is called, causing `undefined` token data and broken refresh behavior.
